source.author: M. L. Rivas
source.license_status: No explicit redistribution license found in the pinned VersaBench/dbms directory; this local implementation is independently written from the documented algorithm and contains no copied source code.

input.layout: [fan, fan+1 boxes in source-list order; each box is lower_T_X_Y_Z followed by upper_T_X_Y_Z]
input.entry_count: fan + 1, the overflowing node entries passed by splitNode
input.box_rule: For every box, lower[d] < upper[d] in all four dimensions.

output.meaning: bit i is 1 iff source entry i belongs to partition group A; unset bits identify group B

profile.seed_rule: enumerate input-order pairs, choosing the pair with the largest 4D union volume; strict greater-than preserves the first pair on ties
profile.assignment_rule: assign each non-seed entry in original order by smaller enlargement relative to the seed box; ties go to B; once a group reaches fan, force remaining entries to the other group
profile.arithmetic: exact integer volumes; bounded results are exactly representable in source Float
profile.scope: R-tree split partitioning helper only; allocation, linked-list mutation, parent adjustment, and recursive insertion are excluded
